simple.summary: יַקִּיר (yaqqîyr) means noble, rare. First listed occurrence: Dan 2 11.

definitions.full: H3358. yaqqir [ יַקִּיר ] adjective honourable, difficult ; — 1 honourable , emphatic יַקִּירָא Ezra 4:10 . 2 difficult (compare Biblical Hebrew כָּבֵד adjective 1 d ), feminine singular יַקִּירָה Dan 2:11 .
